name: aaa_remote_ip_enabled
desc: Enable only, when IP Authorization is enabled in the AAA \ Server

name: asm_group_ranges
desc: ASM group ranges with prefixes (len:4-32) example: 239.1.1.0/25, max 20 ranges. Enabling SPT-Threshold Infinity to prevent switchover to source-tree.

name: bootstrap_conf
desc: Additional CLIs required during device bootup/login e.g. AAA/Radius

name: bootstrap_multisubnet
desc: DHCPv4 Multi Subnet Scope - lines with # prefix are ignored here

name: deploy
desc: This flag does configuration save and deploy

name: deployment_freeze
desc: Disable all deployments in this fabric

name: dhcp_enable
desc: Automatic IP Assignment For POAP From Local DHCP Server

name: dhcp_end
desc: End Address For Switch Out-of-Band POAP

name: dhcp_start
desc: Start Address For Switch Out-of-Band POAP

name: dns_server_ip_list
desc: Comma separated list of IP Addresses (v4/v6)

name: dns_server_vrf
desc: One VRF for all DNS servers or a comma separated list of VRFs, one per DNS server

name: enable_aaa
desc: Include AAA configs from Manageability tab during device bootup

name: enable_asm
desc: Enable groups with receivers sending (*,G) joins

name: enable_nbm_passive
desc: Enable NBM mode to pim-passive for default VRF

name: extra_conf_intra_links
desc: Additional CLIs For All Intra-Fabric Links

name: extra_conf_leaf
desc: Additional CLIs For All Leafs and Tier2 Leafs As Captured From Show Running Configuration

name: extra_conf_spine
desc: Additional CLIs For All Spines As Captured From Show Running Configuration

name: fabric_name
desc: Fabric name to be created, updated or deleted.

name: grfield_debug_flag
desc: Enable to clean switch configuration without reload when PreserveConfig=no

name: isis_p2p_enable
desc: This will enable network point-to-point on fabric interfaces which are numbered

name: link_state_routing_tag
desc: Routing process tag for the fabric

name: mgmt_gw
desc: Default Gateway For Management VRF On The Switch

name: mgmt_prefix
desc: Switch Mgmt IP Subnet Prefix (Min:8, Max:30)

name: ntp_server_ip_list
desc: Comma separated list of IP Addresses (v4/v6)

name: ntp_server_vrf
desc: One VRF for all NTP servers or a comma separated list of VRFs, one per NTP server

name: ospf_area_id
desc: OSPF Area Id in IP address format

name: power_redundancy_mode
desc: Default power supply mode for the fabric

name: ptp_domain_id
desc: Multiple Independent PTP Clocking Subdomains on a Single Network (Min:0, Max:127)

name: snmp_server_host_trap
desc: Configure NDFC as a receiver for SNMP traps

name: static_underlay_ip_alloc
desc: Checking this will disable Dynamic Fabric IP Address Allocations

name: subnet_range
desc: Address range to assign Numbered IPs

name: subnet_target_mask
desc: Mask for Fabric Subnet IP Range

name: syslog_server_ip_list
desc: Comma separated list of IP Addresses (v4/v6)

name: syslog_server_vrf
desc: One VRF for all Syslog servers or a comma separated list of VRFs, one per Syslog server

name: syslog_sev
desc: Comma separated list of Syslog severity values, one per Syslog server (Min:0, Max:7)
